name: Sibraim
meaning: Landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land
notes: Sibraim was a place mentioned by Ezekiel as a landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land, between the territory of Damascus and that of Hamath ( Ezek. 47:16 ).

name: Siddim_Valley
meaning: Valley near the Dead Sea; site of battle
notes: The Valley of Siddim, located near the Dead Sea, was the site of a battle between the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah and the kings of Elam and their allies ( Gen. 14:3, 8, 10 ).

name: Sidon
meaning: Phoenician city; home of Jezebel
notes: Sidon, also called Great Sidon, was a prominent Phoenician city known for its trade and culture, and was the hometown of Jezebel, wife of King Ahab ( 1Ki. 16:31 ). It is mentioned in various contexts throughout the Bible, including the Old Testament ( Gen. 10:19; Josh. 11:8; Judg. 10:6; Isa. 23:2-4; Jer. 27:3; Ezek. 28:21-22 ) and the New Testament ( Matt. 11:21-22; Luke 4:26; Act.27.3 ).

name: Silla
meaning: Place where King Joash was assassinated
notes: Silla was the place where King Joash of Judah was assassinated by his servants ( 2Ki. 12:20 ).

name: Sin
meaning: Wilderness area between Elim and Sinai
notes: Sin was a wilderness area between Elim and Sinai where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to the Promised Land ( Exod. 16:1; 17:1; Num. 33:11-12 ).

name: Sinai
meaning: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments
notes: Sinai, also called Mount Sinai, Horeb, or Mount Horeb, was the mountain where God gave Moses the Ten Commandments and other laws ( Exod. 19-40; Lev. 7:38; 25:1; 26:46; 27:34; Num. 3:1; 28:6; Deut. 33:2; Judg. 5:5; Ps. 68:8, 17; Neh. 9:13; Mal. 4:4; Act.7.30, 38; Gal. 4:24-25 ).

name: Sinai_Wilderness
meaning: Wilderness where Israel camped after leaving Egypt
notes: The Sinai Wilderness was the region where the Israelites camped after the Exodus and received the Law.

name: Siphmoth
meaning: Town in southern Judah that received spoils from David
notes: Siphmoth was one of the towns in southern Judah that received a share of the spoils from David after he defeated the Amalekites ( 1Sam. 30:28 ).

name: Sirah
meaning: Place near Hebron where Abner was killed by Joab
notes: Sirah, also called the Cistern of Sirah, was a place near Hebron where Joab killed Abner in revenge for the death of his brother Asahel ( 2Sam. 3:26 ).

name: Sitnah
meaning: Well dug by Isaac, disputed by Philistines
notes: Sitnah was a well dug by Isaac in the Valley of Gerar, but the Philistines disputed its ownership ( Gen. 26:21 ).

name: Smyrna
meaning: One of the seven churches of Asia Minor
notes: Smyrna was one of the seven churches of Asia Minor addressed in the Book of Revelation, known for its persecution and poverty, yet faithful to Christ ( Rev. 1:11; 2:8-11 ).

name: Socoh
meaning: Town in Judah; site of David's battle with Goliath
notes: Socoh was a town in the Shephelah region of Judah ( Josh. 15:35 ), known for being near the site of David's battle with Goliath ( 1Sam. 17:1 ) and later fortified by Rehoboam ( 2Chr. 11:7 ).

name: Socoh
meaning: A town in the hill country of Judah
notes: Socoh, a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the hill country ( Jos. 15:48 ).

name: Sodom
meaning: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins
notes: Sodom, a notoriously wicked city destroyed by God along with Gomorrah for their grave sins ( Gen. 19:24-25 ).

name: Solomon's_Portico
meaning: Colonnade in Jerusalem's temple where apostles taught
notes: Solomon's Portico, a colonnade in the Jerusalem temple where the apostles gathered to teach ( Act.3.11; 5:12 ).

name: Sorek_Valley
meaning: Valley where Delilah lived, Samson's downfall occurred
notes: Sorek Valley, the place where Delilah lived and where Samson's downfall began ( Judg. 16:4 ).

name: Spain
meaning: Country Paul intended to visit to preach gospel
notes: Spain, a country Paul planned to visit to preach the gospel ( Rom. 15:24, 28 ).

name: Straight
meaning: Street in Damascus where Saul stayed after conversion
notes: Straight, a street in Damascus where Saul stayed in the house of Judas after his conversion ( Act.9.11 ).

name: Succoth
meaning: First Israelite campsite after leaving Egypt during Exodus
notes: Succoth, the first place the Israelites camped after leaving Egypt during the Exodus ( Exod. 12:37; Num. 33:5 ).

name: Succoth
meaning: City in Canaan, location of Solomon's bronze works
notes: Succoth, a city in Canaan allocated to the tribe of Gad, later the site of Solomon's bronze works ( Gen. 33:17; Josh. 13:27; 1Kgs. 7:46 ).

name: Suph
meaning: Place near where Moses spoke to Israel
notes: Suph, a place near the wilderness where Moses spoke to the Israelites ( Deut. 1:1 ).

name: Suphah
meaning: Place mentioned in the Book of the Wars of the Lord
notes: Suphah, a place mentioned in the Book of the Wars of the Lord ( Num. 21:14 ).

name: Sur
meaning: Gate of the temple in Jerusalem
notes: Sur, a gate of the temple in Jerusalem, possibly referring to the Foundation Gate ( 2Kgs. 11:6 ).

name: Susa
meaning: Capital city of the Persian Empire
notes: Susa, the capital city of the Persian Empire, where Esther lived and the events of her book took place ( Esth. 1:2; Dan. 8:2 ).

name: Sychar
meaning: Samaritan city near Jacob's well
notes: Sychar, a Samaritan city near Jacob's well, where Jesus spoke with a Samaritan woman ( Jhn.4.5 ).

name: Syene
meaning: Southern border of Egypt, modern-day Aswan
notes: Syene, the southern border of Egypt, mentioned in prophecies about Egypt's destruction ( Ezek. 29:10; 30:6 ).

name: Syracuse
meaning: City in Sicily where Paul's ship stopped
notes: Syracuse, a city on the island of Sicily where Paul's ship stopped for three days on his journey to Rome ( Act.28.12 ).

name: Syria
meaning: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict
notes: Syria, an ancient region north of Israel, often engaged in conflicts with Israel and Judah ( 1Kgs. 20:1; 2Kgs. 13:3 ).

name: Syrtis
meaning: Dangerous shallow waters off the coast of Libya
notes: Syrtis, a dangerous area of shallow waters off the coast of Libya, feared by sailors ( Act.27.17 ).

name: Taanach
meaning: Canaanite city allotted to Manasseh, later a Levitical city
notes: Taanach, a Canaanite city allotted to the tribe of Manasseh, later designated as a Levitical city ( Josh. 12:21; 17:11; 21:25 ).

name: Taanath-shiloh
meaning: Landmark on the border of Ephraim's territory
notes: Taanath-shiloh, a landmark on the eastern border of the territory allotted to the tribe of Ephraim ( Josh. 16:6 ).

name: Tabbath
meaning: Place near where Midianites fled from Gideon
notes: Tabbath, a place near the Jordan River where the Midianites fled after being defeated by Gideon ( Judg. 7:22 ).

name: Taberah
meaning: Israelite camp where God sent fire as judgment
notes: Taberah, a place where the Israelites camped and experienced God's judgment by fire for their complaints ( Num. 11:3; Deut. 9:22 ).

name: Tabor
meaning: Oak tree near Bethel, mentioned in Samuel's prophecy
notes: Tabor, an oak tree near Bethel, mentioned in Samuel's prophetic message to Saul ( 1Sam. 10:3 ).

name: Tabor_Mount
meaning: Mountain in Israel, site of Deborah and Barak's victory
notes: Mount Tabor, a mountain in Israel, known for the gathering of Deborah and Barak's forces and their victory over Sisera ( Judg. 4:6, 12, 14 ).

name: Tadmor
meaning: City built by Solomon in the wilderness
notes: Tadmor (or Tamar), a city built by Solomon in the wilderness, possibly the later site of Palmyra ( 1Kgs. 9:18; 2Chr. 8:4 ).

name: Tahath
meaning: Israelite campsite during the wilderness journey
notes: Tahath, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey ( Num. 33:26-27 ).

name: Tahpanhes
meaning: Egyptian city where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem's destruction
notes: Tahpanhes (or Tehaphnehes), an Egyptian city where Jewish refugees, including Jeremiah, settled after the destruction of Jerusalem ( Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18 ).

name: Tamar
meaning: Landmark on the southeastern border of Israel
notes: Tamar, a place mentioned as a landmark on the southeastern border of the Promised Land ( Ezek. 47:18-19; 48:28 ).

name: Tappuah
meaning: Canaanite city allotted to Ephraim and Manasseh
notes: Tappuah (or En-tappuah), a Canaanite city on the border between Ephraim and Manasseh, allotted to Manasseh but with land belonging to Ephraim ( Josh. 16:8; 17:7-8 ).

name: Tappuah
meaning: Town in the Judean Shephelah
notes: Tappuah, a town in the Shephelah (lowlands) of Judah ( Josh. 15:34 ).

name: Taralah
meaning: Town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin
notes: Taralah, a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin ( Josh. 18:27 ).

name: Tarshish
meaning: Distant maritime city known for its wealth and trade
notes: Tarshish, a distant maritime city known for its ships, wealth, and trade, possibly located in southern Spain ( 1Kgs. 10:22; Isa. 23:1; Jonah 1:3 ).

name: Tarsus
meaning: City in Cilicia, birthplace of the apostle Paul
notes: Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, known as the birthplace and early residence of the apostle Paul ( Act.9.11, 30; 21:39; 22:3 ).

name: Tekoa
meaning: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos
notes: Tekoa, a town in Judah, known as the birthplace of the prophet Amos and the home of one of David's mighty men ( 2Sam. 14:2; 1Chr. 11:28; Amo.1.1 ).

name: Tel-abib
meaning: Settlement of exiled Jews in Babylonia
notes: Tel-abib, a settlement of exiled Jews by the Chebar River in Babylonia, where the prophet Ezekiel lived ( Ezek. 3:15 ).

name: Telaim
meaning: Place where Saul gathered his army
notes: Telaim, a place where Saul gathered his army before attacking the Amalekites ( 1Sam. 15:4 ).

name: Telassar
meaning: Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians
notes: Telassar, a Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians, mentioned in the context of Sennacherib's boasting ( 2Kgs. 19:12; Isa. 37:12 ).

name: Telem
meaning: Town in the Negev region of Judah
notes: Telem, a town in the Negev region of Judah, allotted to the tribe of Judah ( Josh. 15:24 ).

name: Tel-harsha
meaning: Babylonian city from which exiles returned
notes: Tel-harsha, a Babylonian city from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem, but could not prove their genealogy ( Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61 ).

name: Tel-melah
meaning: Babylonian city from which exiles returned
notes: Tel-melah, a Babylonian city from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem, but could not prove their genealogy ( Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61 ).

name: Tema
meaning: Arabian city and tribe known for trade
notes: Tema, an Arabian city and tribe known for its caravans and trade, mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts ( Job.6.19; Isa. 21:14; Jer. 25:23 ).

name: Teman
meaning: Region and town in Edom, known for wisdom
notes: Teman, a region and town in Edom, named after Esau's grandson, known for its wisdom ( Jer. 49:7; Amo.1.12; Obad. 1:9 ).

name: Terah
meaning: Israelite campsite during the wilderness journey
notes: Terah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey ( Num. 33:27-28 ).

name: Thebes
meaning: Ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power
notes: Thebes, an ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power, mentioned in prophecies of judgment against Egypt ( Jer. 46:25; Ezek. 30:14-16; Nah. 3:8 ).

name: Thebez
meaning: Canaanite city where Abimelech was killed
notes: Thebez, a Canaanite city where Abimelech was fatally wounded by a millstone thrown by a woman ( Judg. 9:50-54; 2Sam. 11:21 ).

name: Thessalonica
meaning: Macedonian city, site of an early Christian church
notes: Thessalonica, a prominent city in Macedonia, where Paul established a church and wrote two epistles to the believers ( Act.17.1-9; 1Thess. 1:1; 2Thess. 1:1 ).

name: Three_Taverns
meaning: Staging post on the Appian Way near Rome
notes: Three Taverns, a staging post on the Appian Way, about 33 miles from Rome, where Paul was met by Roman Christians ( Act.28.15 ).

name: Thyatira
meaning: City in Asia Minor, home of the prophet Lydia
notes: Thyatira, a city in Asia Minor, known for its dyeing industry and the home of Lydia, a convert of Paul ( Act.16.14; Rev. 1:11; 2:18, 24 ).

name: Tibhath
meaning: City from which David took bronze for the Temple
notes: Tibhath, a city from which David took a large amount of bronze, used in the construction of the Temple ( 1Chr. 18:8 ).

name: Tigris
meaning: River flowing from Eden, mentioned in Daniel's vision
notes: Tigris, one of the rivers flowing from the Garden of Eden ( Gen. 2:14 ), and the location of Daniel's vision ( Dan. 10:4 ).

name: Timnah
meaning: Canaanite city associated with Judah and Dan
notes: Timnah, a Canaanite city on the border between Judah and Dan, associated with Judah's son Er and Samson ( Gen. 38:12-14; Josh. 15:10; 19:43; Judg. 14:1-5 ).

name: Timnah
meaning: Town in the hill country of Judah
notes: Timnah, a town in the hill country of Judah ( Josh. 15:57 ).

name: Timnath-heres
meaning: Town allotted to Joshua, where he was buried
notes: Timnath-heres (or Timnath-serah), a town in the hill country of Ephraim, allotted to Joshua, where he was buried ( Josh. 19:50; 24:30; Judg. 2:9 ).

name: Tiphsah
meaning: City on the Euphrates, extent of Solomon's kingdom
notes: Tiphsah, a city on the Euphrates River, marking the extent of Solomon's kingdom ( 1Kgs. 4:24 ).

name: Tiphsah
meaning: City attacked by King Menahem of Israel
notes: Tiphsah, a city attacked and brutally conquered by Menahem, king of Israel ( 2Kgs. 15:16 ).

name: Tirzah
meaning: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel
notes: Tirzah, a Canaanite city captured by Joshua, later served as the capital of the northern kingdom of Israel before Samaria ( Josh. 12:24; 1Kgs. 14:17; 15:21, 33; 16:6-23 ).

name: Tishbe
meaning: Hometown of the prophet Elijah
notes: Tishbe (or Tishbite), the hometown of the prophet Elijah, located in Gilead ( 1Kgs. 17:1; 21:17, 28; 2Kgs. 1:3, 8; 9:36 ).

name: Tob
meaning: Region where Jephthah fled and recruited mercenaries
notes: Tob (or Ish-tob), a region east of the Jordan River where Jephthah fled and later recruited mercenaries to fight the Ammonites ( Judg. 11:3, 5; 2Sam. 10:6, 8 ).

name: Tochen
meaning: Town in the territory of Simeon
notes: Tochen, a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon ( 1Chr. 4:32 ).

name: Tolad
meaning: Town in the territory of Simeon
notes: Tolad, a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon ( 1Chr. 4:29 ).

name: Tophel
meaning: A place near where Moses addressed the Israelites
notes: Tophel, a location mentioned in Moses' speech to the Israelites, possibly near modern-day et-Tafeleh, southeast of the Dead Sea ( Deut. 1:1 ).

name: Topheth
meaning: Site of pagan child sacrifice, south of Jerusalem
notes: Topheth, located in the Valley of Hinnom (also called the Valley of Slaughter or Baca Valley) south of Jerusalem, was a site of pagan child sacrifice that was defiled by King Josiah ( 2Ki.23.10; Jer.7.31-32; 19:2, 6, 11-14; 32:35; Isa.30.33 ).

name: Tower_of_Eder
meaning: A tower near Bethlehem, associated with the Messiah
notes: The Tower of Eder, a watchtower near Bethlehem, where Jacob pitched his tent and later associated with the coming of the Messiah ( Gen. 35:21; Mic. 4:8 ).

name: Tower_of_Hananel
meaning: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
notes: The Tower of Hananel, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in prophetic visions of the city's restoration ( Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10 ).

name: Tower_of_the_Hundred
meaning: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
notes: The Tower of the Hundred, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's restoration of the city ( Neh. 3:1; 12:39 ).

name: Tower_of_the_Ovens
meaning: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
notes: The Tower of the Ovens, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's restoration of the city ( Neh. 3:11; 12:38 ).

name: Trachonitis
meaning: A rugged region northeast of the Jordan River
notes: Trachonitis, a rugged, rocky region northeast of the Jordan River, part of Philip's tetrarchy during the time of John the Baptist ( Luke 3:1 ).

name: Travelers_Valley
meaning: A valley where Gog's army will be buried
notes: The Valley of the Travelers, a location where the army of Gog will be buried after their defeat, blocking the path of travelers ( Ezek. 39:11 ).

name: Troas
meaning: A city in Asia Minor, visited by Paul
notes: Troas, a city in Asia Minor, where Paul had a vision of a man urging him to come to Macedonia, and where he later preached and raised Eutychus from the dead ( Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13 ).

name: Trogyllium
meaning: A city near Ephesus, visited by Paul
notes: Trogyllium, a coastal town near Ephesus, where Paul's ship anchored during his journey to Jerusalem ( Act.20.15 ).

name: Tubal
meaning: A nation, descendant of Japheth, known for trading
notes: Tubal, a nation descended from Japheth, known for trading in slaves and bronze, and allied with Gog in the prophecy of Ezekiel ( Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1 ).

name: Tyre
meaning: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade
notes: Tyre, a prominent Phoenician port city, known for its wealth, trade, and craftsmanship, often mentioned in the context of judgment and prophecy ( Josh. 19:29; 2Sam. 5:11; 1Kgs. 5:1; Isa. 23:1-17; Ezek. 26-28; Matt. 11:21-22; Act.12.20 ).

name: Ulai
meaning: A river in Elam, near where Daniel saw a vision
notes: Ulai, a river in Elam, near Susa, where Daniel received a vision of a ram and a goat ( Dan. 8:2, 16 ).

name: Ummah
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Asher
notes: Ummah, a town allotted to the tribe of Asher in the division of the Promised Land ( Josh. 19:30 ).

name: Uphaz
meaning: A place known for its fine gold
notes: Uphaz, a place mentioned in the Bible, known for its high-quality gold ( Jer. 10:9; Dan. 10:5 ).

name: Ur
meaning: The hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia
notes: Ur of the Chaldeans, the hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia, from where God called him to go to the land of Canaan ( Gen. 11:28, 31; 15:7; Neh. 9:7 ).

name: Uz
meaning: A region associated with Job, Edom, and Arabia
notes: Uz, a region mentioned in the Bible as the homeland of Job, possibly located in Edom or Arabia ( Job.1.1; Jer. 25:20; Lam. 4:21 ).

name: Uzal
meaning: A place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
notes: Uzal, a place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy, possibly referring to a region in Arabia known for its high-quality swords ( Ezek. 27:19 ).

name: Uzza
meaning: A garden where Manasseh and Amon were buried
notes: Uzza, a garden in Jerusalem where Manasseh and his son Amon, kings of Judah, were buried ( 2Kgs. 21:18, 26 ).

name: Uzzen-sheerah
meaning: A town built by Sheerah, daughter of Ephraim
notes: Uzzen-sheerah, a town built by Sheerah, the daughter of Ephraim, along with the towns of Upper and Lower Beth-horon ( 1Chr. 7:24 ).

name: Valley_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
notes: The Valley Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in connection with King Uzziah's fortifications ( 2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13 ).

name: Vedan
meaning: A place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
notes: Vedan, a place of uncertain location, mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy as trading with Tyre ( Ezek. 27:19 ).

name: Waheb
meaning: A place mentioned in the Book of Numbers
notes: Waheb, a place mentioned in the Book of Numbers, possibly located in Moab ( Num. 21:14 ).

name: Washer's_Field
meaning: A location near Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in prophecies
notes: The Washer's Field, a location near Jerusalem's wall, where the Assyrian officials stood and delivered messages to King Hezekiah ( 2Kgs. 18:17; Isa. 7:3; 36:2 ).

name: Water_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
notes: The Water Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and associated with the reading of the Law and the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles ( Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37 ).

name: Way_of_Holiness
meaning: A prophesied highway for the redeemed in Isaiah
notes: The Way of Holiness, a prophesied highway in Isaiah, reserved for the redeemed and leading to Zion ( Isa. 35:8 ).

name: Wildgoats_Rocks
meaning: A place near En Gedi where David hid from Saul
notes: Wildgoats Rocks, a rugged area near En Gedi where David hid from Saul and had the opportunity to spare the king's life ( 1Sam. 24:2 ).

name: Yeshanah_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
notes: The Yeshanah Gate, also known as the Old Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall rebuilt by Nehemiah ( Neh. 3:6; 12:39 ).

name: Yiron
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Naphtali
notes: Yiron, a town in the territory of Naphtali, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land ( Josh. 19:38 ).

name: Zaanan
meaning: A town mentioned in Micah's prophecy
notes: Zaanan, a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, possibly located in the Shephelah region of Judah ( Mic. 1:11 ).

name: Zaanannim
meaning: A place near Kedesh in Naphtali
notes: Zaanannim, a place near Kedesh in Naphtali, associated with the Kenites and mentioned in connection with the story of Deborah and Barak ( Josh. 19:33; Judg. 4:11 ).

name: Zalmonah
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
notes: Zalmonah, a campsite of the Israelites during their wilderness journey, located between Mount Hor and Punon ( Num. 33:41-42 ).

name: Zanoah
meaning: A town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah
notes: Zanoah, a town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah, whose inhabitants helped rebuild the Valley Gate during Nehemiah's time ( Josh. 15:34; 1Chr. 4:18; Neh. 3:13; 11:30 ).

name: Zanoah
meaning: A town in the hill country of Judah
notes: Zanoah, a town in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe ( Josh. 15:56 ).

name: Zaphon
meaning: A city in Gad and a term for the north
notes: Zaphon, a city allotted to the tribe of Gad, also used as a term for the north or the heavenly dwelling place of God ( Josh. 13:27; Judg. 12:1; Ps. 48:2; Isa. 14:13 ).

name: Zarephath
meaning: A Phoenician city where Elijah stayed with a widow
notes: Zarephath, a Phoenician city between Tyre and Sidon, where Elijah stayed with a widow during a famine and performed miracles ( 1Kgs. 17:9-10; Obad. 1:20; Luke 4:26 ).

name: Zarethan
meaning: A place near the Jordan River associated with Israel's crossing
notes: Zarethan, a place near Adam and the Jordan River, mentioned in connection with Israel's crossing and the casting of bronze implements for Solomon's Temple ( Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22 ).

name: Zeboiim
meaning: One of the cities of the plain destroyed with Sodom
notes: Zeboiim, one of the cities of the plain, along with Sodom and Gomorrah, that was destroyed by God due to its wickedness ( Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8 ).

name: Zeboim
meaning: A town resettled by the people of Judah after the exile
notes: Zeboim, a town resettled by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile ( Neh. 11:34 ).

name: Zeboim_Valley
meaning: A valley mentioned in connection with Saul's military campaigns
notes: The Valley of Zeboim, a location mentioned in the context of Saul's military campaigns against the Philistines ( 1Sam. 13:18 ).

name: Zedad
meaning: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land
notes: Zedad, a place mentioned as part of the northern border of the Promised Land in both the Mosaic and Ezekiel's descriptions ( Num. 34:8; Ezek. 47:15 ).

name: Zela
meaning: A city in Benjamin where Saul's family was buried
notes: Zela was a city in Benjamin where Saul and his family were buried .

name: Zelzah
meaning: A place near Rachel's tomb in Benjamin
notes: Zelzah was a place near Rachel's tomb in Benjamin that Samuel referenced when giving directions to Saul .

name: Zemaraim
meaning: A town in Benjamin; also a hill in Ephraim
notes: Zemaraim was a town allotted to Benjamin ( Jos.18.22 ). Mount Zemaraim in Ephraim was where Abijah addressed Jeroboam's army .

name: Zenan
meaning: A town in the Judean lowlands
notes: Zenan was a town in the lowlands of Judah .

name: Zephathah_Valley
meaning: A valley where Asa defeated the Cushite army
notes: The Valley of Zephathah is where King Asa of Judah defeated Zerah the Cushite's large army .

name: Zer
meaning: A fortified city in Naphtali
notes: Zer was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali .

name: Zered
meaning: A brook marking the end of Israel's wilderness wanderings
notes: The Zered Brook marked the end of Israel's 38 years of wilderness wanderings until they crossed it to enter Moab .

name: Zeredah
meaning: The hometown of Jeroboam, first king of Israel
notes: Zeredah was the hometown of Jeroboam, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel .

name: Zereth-shahar
meaning: A city in Reuben's territory by the Dead Sea
notes: Zereth-shahar was a city in the territory of Reuben, located on a mountain in the plain by the Dead Sea .

name: Ziddim
meaning: A fortified city in Naphtali
notes: Ziddim was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali .

name: Ziklag
meaning: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's
notes: Ziklag was a city allotted to Judah and Simeon that was later given to David by the Philistine king Achish .

name: Zimri
meaning: A nation mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against nations
notes: Zimri was a nation mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy of God's judgment against various nations .

name: Zin
meaning: A desert and wilderness region south of Judah
notes: The Wilderness of Zin was a desert region south of Judah where the Israelites encamped during their wilderness wanderings .

name: Zior
meaning: A town in the hill country of Judah
notes: Zior was a town in the hill country of Judah .

name: Ziph
meaning: A town in the Negev of Judah
notes: Ziph was a town in the Negev region of Judah .

name: Ziph
meaning: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul
notes: Ziph was a town in the hill country of Judah where David hid from Saul in the nearby wilderness .

name: Ziphron
meaning: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land
notes: Ziphron was a place on the northern border of the Promised Land .

name: Ziz
meaning: A pass where Jehoshaphat defeated Moab and Ammon
notes: The Ascent of Ziz was a pass where Jehoshaphat defeated the armies of Moab and Ammon .

name: Zoan
meaning: An ancient Egyptian city, probably Tanis
notes: Zoan was an ancient Egyptian city where God performed miracles through Moses; it is probably to be identified with Tanis .

name: Zoar
meaning: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction
notes: Zoar, also known as Bela, was a small city near Sodom where Lot fled when God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah .

name: Zobah
meaning: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign
notes: Zobah was an Aramean kingdom northeast of Israel, conquered by David and later a source of opposition to Solomon .

name: Zophim
meaning: A place in Moab where Balaam blessed Israel
notes: The field of Zophim was a place on the top of Pisgah in Moab where Balaam blessed Israel .

name: Zorah
meaning: A town in the Shephelah, home of Samson
notes: Zorah was a town in the Shephelah region, originally allotted to Judah and later to Dan, and was the hometown of Samson .

name: Zuph
meaning: A land where Saul searched for his father's donkeys
notes: The land of Zuph was a region in Ephraim where Saul and his servant searched for his father's lost donkeys .

name: Abaddon
meaning: The angel of the bottomless pit, meaning "destruction"
notes: Abaddon (Hebrew) or Apollyon (Greek), meaning "destruction" or "destroyer," is the name of the angel of the bottomless pit and the name of the pit itself.

name: Abib
meaning: The first month of the Hebrew religious calendar
notes: Abib, later known as Nisan, was the first month of the Hebrew religious calendar, in which the Passover was celebrated .

name: Adar
meaning: The twelfth month of the Hebrew religious calendar
notes: Adar was the twelfth month of the Hebrew religious calendar, in which the feast of Purim was celebrated .

name: Alamoth
meaning: A musical term, possibly referring to a high pitch
notes: Alamoth is a musical term used in the superscriptions of some Psalms, possibly referring to a high pitch or a musical instrument .

name: Alpha
meaning: A title of Jesus, signifying His eternal nature
notes: In Revelation 1:8, 21:6; 22:13 , Jesus is referred to as "the Alpha and the Omega," a title that emphasizes His eternal nature and His role as the beginning and the end of all things.

name: Al-taschith
meaning: Musical or literary term in Psalms, meaning "Do Not Destroy"
notes: Al-taschith, meaning "Do Not Destroy," appears in the titles of Psalms 57, 58, 59, and 75, possibly indicating a musical or literary term.

name: Amon
meaning: Egyptian god; city in Nahum, probably Thebes
notes: Amon, mentioned in Jeremiah 46:25; Nam.3.8 , refers to the Egyptian god Amon and the city of Thebes, respectively.

name: Apharsachite
meaning: Apharsathchites: A group opposing the rebuilding of Jerusalem's temple
notes: The Apharsathchites were a group that opposed the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem during the time of Ezra ( Ezra 4:9; 5:6; 6:6 ).

name: Artemis
meaning: Greek goddess worshipped in Ephesus, associated with fertility
notes: Artemis, a Greek goddess worshipped in Ephesus, was the focus of a major controversy during Paul's ministry in the city ( Act.19.24, 27, 28, 34, 35 ).

name: Asherah
meaning: Canaanite goddess; associated with wooden poles, idolatry
notes: Asherah, a Canaanite goddess, was worshipped by the Israelites through wooden poles or images, often leading them into idolatry.

name: Ashima
meaning: Deity worshipped by the people of Hamath
notes: Ashima was a deity worshipped by the people of Hamath who were resettled in Samaria by the Assyrian king ( 2Ki.17.30 ).

name: Ashtaroth
meaning: A Canaanite goddess of fertility and war
notes: Ashtaroth was a Canaanite goddess of fertility and war whose worship was condemned in the Bible.

name: Ashtoreth
meaning: A Syrian goddess of fertility and war
notes: Ashtoreth, was a Sidonian goddess of fertility and war whose worship was condemned in the Bible.

name: Azazel
meaning: Mysterious figure connected to the Day of Atonement
notes: Azazel, mentioned in Leviticus 16, is a mysterious figure connected to the scapegoat ritual on the Day of Atonement.

name: Baal
meaning: Canaanite god, "Lord/God of the Covenant"
notes: Baal-berith or El-berith, meaning "Lord of the Covenant" or "God of the Covenant," was a Canaanite deity worshipped by the Israelites in Shechem during the time of the judges ( Judges 8:33; 9:4, 46 ).

name: Baal-berith
meaning: Canaanite god of fertility and weather
notes: Baal, a Canaanite god of fertility and weather, and Peor, a Moabite god, were worshipped by the Israelites, leading them into idolatry and disobedience to the Lord.

name: Bear
meaning: Constellation mentioned in God's discourse with Job
notes: The Bear is a constellation referred to in God's speeches to Job, showcasing God's power and wisdom in creation.

name: Behemoth
meaning: A powerful, majestic creature described in the Bible
notes: Behemoth, mentioned in Job.40.15 , is a powerful and majestic creature that God uses to illustrate His creative power and sovereignty.

name: Bel
meaning: Babylonian god, associated with Marduk
notes: Bel, a Babylonian god mentioned in Isaiah 46:1 and Jeremiah 50:2; 51:44 ), is associated with the god Marduk and is depicted as bowing down and being humiliated by the Lord.

name: Boaz
meaning: One of two bronze pillars in Solomon's Temple
notes: Boaz was the name given to one of the two bronze pillars that stood at the entrance of Solomon's Temple ( 1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17 ).

name: Booths_Festival
meaning: Jewish festival commemorating the Israelites' wilderness wanderings
notes: The Booths_Festival, also known as the Feast of Tabernacles or Sukkot, was a Jewish festival commemorating the Israelites' wilderness wanderings and God's provision ( Jhn.7.2 ).

name: Bul
meaning: The eighth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
notes: Bul, mentioned in 1Ki.6.38 , is the eighth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to October-November in the modern calendar.

name: Chemosh
meaning: Moabite god, worshipped by Solomon and others
notes: Chemosh, the god of the Moabites, was worshipped by Solomon and the Israelites, leading them into idolatry.

name: Chislev
meaning: The ninth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
notes: Chislev, mentioned in Nehemiah 1:1 and Zechariah 7:1 , is the ninth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to November-December in the modern calendar.

name: Chronicles
meaning: Historical records of the kings of Israel and Judah
notes: The Chronicles, mentioned throughout the books of Kings and Chronicles, were historical records of the reigns of the kings of Israel and Judah.

name: Dagon
meaning: Philistine god whose temple was destroyed by Samson
notes: Dagon was the chief deity of the Philistines, with temples at Gaza and Ashdod.

name: Dedication_Festival
meaning: Jewish festival commemorating the rededication of the Temple
notes: The Dedication_Festival, also known as Hanukkah, was a Jewish festival that commemorated the rededication of the Temple in Jerusalem ( Jhn.10.22 ).

name: Destiny
meaning: A pagan deity mentioned in the Book of Isaiah
notes: Destiny, mentioned in Isaiah 65:11 , is a pagan deity associated with fate or fortune, which some Israelites worshipped, forsaking the Lord.

name: Elul
meaning: The sixth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
notes: Elul, mentioned in Nehemiah 6:15 , is the sixth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to August-September in the modern calendar.

name: Epicurean
meaning: A philosophical school in ancient Greece, mentioned in Acts
notes: Epicureans, mentioned in Act.17.18 , were adherents of a philosophical school in ancient Greece that emphasized the pursuit of pleasure and the avoidance of pain.

name: Ethanim
meaning: The seventh month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
notes: Ethanim, mentioned in 1Ki.8.2 , is the seventh month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to September-October in the modern calendar.

name: Fortune
meaning: A pagan deity associated with luck and prosperity
notes: Fortune, mentioned in Isaiah 65:11 , is a pagan deity associated with luck and prosperity, which some Israelites worshipped, forsaking the Lord.

name: Freedmen
meaning: Former slaves who had been granted freedom
notes: The Freedmen, mentioned in Act.6.9 , were likely former Jewish slaves who had been granted freedom and had their own synagogue in Jerusalem.

name: Gabriel
meaning: An angel who delivers messages from God
notes: Gabriel is an angel who appears in the Bible to deliver important messages from God, such as interpreting visions for Daniel ( Dan.8.16; 9:21 ) and announcing the births of John the Baptist and Jesus ( Luke 1:19, 26 ).

name: Gittith
meaning: A musical term in the superscriptions of Psalms
notes: Gittith, mentioned in the superscriptions of Psalms 8, 81, and 84, is a musical term of uncertain meaning, possibly referring to a musical instrument, a tune, or a style associated with the city of Gath.

name: Hermes
meaning: Greek god, associated with Paul and Barnabas
notes: In Act.14.12 , the people of Lystra identified Paul as Hermes, the Greek god of messages and eloquence, because he was the chief speaker.

name: Herodian
meaning: A Jewish political party supporting the Herodian dynasty
notes: The Herodians, mentioned in Matthew 22:16; Mrk.3.6; 12.13 , were a Jewish political party that supported the rule of the Herodian dynasty and collaborated with the Pharisees in their opposition to Jesus.

name: Higgaion
meaning: A musical or literary term in the Psalms
notes: Higgaion, mentioned in Psalm 9:16 , is a musical or literary term of uncertain meaning, possibly indicating a pause for meditation or reflection.

name: Hosanna
meaning: A Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please"
notes: Hosanna, a Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please," was shouted by the crowds during Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem, acknowledging Him as the Messiah ( Matthew 21:9, 15; Mrk.11.9-10; Jhn.12.13 ).

name: Jachin
meaning: One of two bronze pillars in Solomon's Temple
notes: Jachin was the name given to one of the two bronze pillars that stood at the entrance of Solomon's Temple ( 1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17 ).

name: Jonath-elem-rechokim
meaning: A musical term in the superscription of Psalm 56
notes: Jonath-elem-rechokim, meaning "Dove on Far-off Terebinths," is a musical term or phrase found in the superscription of Psalm 56, possibly indicating the melody or musical setting to which the psalm was to be sung.

name: Judaism
meaning: The monotheistic religion of the Jewish people
notes: In Galatians 1:13-14 , Paul refers to his former way of life in Judaism, emphasizing his zealous adherence to the traditions of his ancestors before his conversion to Christianity.

name: Kiyyun
meaning: Astral deity worshiped by Israelites, provoking God's judgment
notes: Kiyyun was an astral deity that the Israelites worshiped, leading to God's judgment and their exile.

name: Legion
meaning: Name of a demon or group of demons
notes: In the New Testament, Legion is the name given to a demon or group of demons that possessed a man in the region of the Gerasenes ( Mrk.5.9; Luke 8:30 ).

name: Leviathan
meaning: A large sea creature mentioned in the Bible
notes: Leviathan is a large sea creature mentioned in several Old Testament passages, often associated with chaos, evil, or God's power over creation ( Job.3.8; 41:1; Psalm 74:14; 104:26; Isaiah 27:1 ).

name: LORD
meaning: Names or title used to refer to God
notes: Throughout the Bible, God is referred to by various names and titles, each revealing different aspects of His character, nature, and relationship with His people.

name: Lucifer
meaning: Symbolic name referring to the king of Babylon's fall
notes: Isaiah poetically describes the king of Babylon as Lucifer, portraying his fall from power.

name: Mahalath
meaning: A musical or literary term in the Psalms
notes: Mahalath, mentioned in the superscriptions of Psalms 53 and 88, is a musical or literary term of uncertain meaning.

name: Maranatha
meaning: An Aramaic expression meaning "Our Lord, come!"
notes: Maranatha is an Aramaic expression that means "Our Lord, come!" and is used in 1Co.16.22 as a prayer for the Lord's return.

name: Maskil
meaning: A musical or literary term in the Psalms
notes: Maskil is a term found in the superscriptions of several psalms, possibly indicating a contemplative or instructive psalm or a specific musical style.

name: Mazzaroth
meaning: A term related to astronomy or constellations
notes: Mazzaroth, mentioned in Job.38.32 , is a term of uncertain meaning, possibly referring to constellations or the zodiac.

name: Merodach
meaning: Chief god of Babylon
notes: Merodach, also known as Bel, was the chief god of the Babylonian pantheon.

name: Messiah
meaning: The anointed one, a title for Jesus Christ.
notes: Messiah, meaning "anointed one," is a title used for Jesus Christ.

name: Miktam
meaning: A musical or literary term used in Psalm titles.
notes: Miktam is a musical or literary term of uncertain meaning used in Psalm titles.

name: Molech
meaning: Canaanite deity associated with child sacrifice.
notes: Molech (or Milcom or Moloch) was a Canaanite deity associated with child sacrifice.

name: Muth-labben
meaning: Musical term or tune in a psalm title
notes: Muth-labben, a phrase of uncertain meaning, appears in the title of Psalm 9.

name: Nazirites
meaning: Person who took a special vow of dedication
notes: A Nazirite was an individual who took a special vow of dedication to God, abstaining from wine, cutting hair, and avoiding corpses.

name: Nebo
meaning: A Babylonian god and a mountain in Moab
notes: Nebo, mentioned in Isaiah 46:1, is a Babylonian god of wisdom and writing, and also the name of a mountain in Moab where Moses viewed the Promised Land before his death ( Deu.32.49; 34:1 ).

name: Nehushtan
meaning: The bronze serpent made by Moses in the wilderness
notes: Nehushtan, mentioned in 2Ki.18.4 , was the name given to the bronze serpent that Moses made in the wilderness ( Numbers 21:8-9 ), which had become an object of idolatrous worship by the time of King Hezekiah.

name: Nergal
meaning: A Mesopotamian god worshipped by the Assyrians
notes: Nergal, mentioned in 2Ki.17.30 , was a Mesopotamian god of war, pestilence, and the underworld, worshipped by the men of Cuth who were brought to Samaria by the Assyrians.

name: New_Moon
meaning: New Moon: A religious observance marking the beginning of months
notes: The New Moon, mentioned in Col.2.16 , was a religious observance marking the beginning of each month in the Hebrew calendar, often celebrated with special sacrifices and feasts.

name: Nibhaz
meaning: Idol god worshiped by the Avvites in Samaria
notes: Nibhaz was a deity worshiped by the Avvite people who settled in Samaria.

name: Nicolaitans
meaning: A group whose practices were condemned by Jesus
notes: The Nicolaitans, mentioned in Revelation 2:6; 2:15 , were a group whose practices were hated by Jesus and condemned by the early church.

name: Nisroch
meaning: An Assyrian deity, possibly associated with agriculture
notes: Nisroch, mentioned in 2Ki.19.37; Isaiah 37:38 , was an Assyrian deity in whose temple King Sennacherib was worshipping when he was assassinated by his sons.
